This is a simple notebook to launch the VSCode server on the 
cluster. It will build a singularity container with all the 
dependencies and launch the server.

```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import os
import subprocess
import tomllib
import tomli_w
import yaml
from rich.console import Console
from rich.panel import Panel
from rich.columns import Columns
from rich.syntax import Syntax

from spython.main import Client
from spython.main.parse.recipe import Recipe
from spython.main.parse.writers import SingularityWriter

console = Console()
```

```{python}
def spython_exec(
    command,
    *,
    image,
    writable=False,
    fakeroot=False,
    bind_project=False,
):
    options = ["--no-home"]

    if writable:
        options.append("--writable")

    if fakeroot:
        options.append("--fakeroot")

    if bind_project:
        options += ["--bind", f"{PROJECT_DIR}:/work"]

    return Client.execute(
        image=str(image),
        command=["bash", "--noprofile", "--norc", "-c", command],
        options=options,
        sudo=False,
        return_result=True,
    )


def normalize_spython_result(result):
    message = result.get("message", "")
    return_code = result.get("return_code", None)

    if isinstance(message, list):
        stdout = message[0] if len(message) > 0 else ""
        stderr = message[1] if len(message) > 1 else ""
    else:
        stdout = message or ""
        stderr = ""

    return {
        "stdout": stdout,
        "stderr": stderr,
        "return_code": return_code,
        "raw": result,
    }


def show_spython(result, *, tail=None):
    result = normalize_spython_result(result)

    stdout = result["stdout"]
    stderr = result["stderr"]

    if tail:
        stdout = "\n".join(stdout.splitlines()[-tail:])
        stderr = "\n".join(stderr.splitlines()[-tail:])

    console.print(
        Panel(
            Columns([
                Panel(Syntax(stdout or "<empty>", "text"), title="stdout / message", border_style="green"),
                Panel(Syntax(stderr or "<empty>", "text"), title="stderr", border_style="red" if result["return_code"] else "yellow"),
            ]),
            title=f"Exit code: {result['return_code']}",
            border_style="green" if result["return_code"] == 0 else "red",
        )
    )

    return result
```

To first _provision_ the container, we take the build image from `setup.qmd` 
and install the spack stack. This will take a few minutes to complete.

```{python}
import submitit
from pathlib import Path

PROJECT_NAME = "prospectorDHSNepal"

PROJECT_DIR = Path("/n/holylabs/LABS/cgolden_lab/Lab/frontier/works/prospectors") / PROJECT_NAME

SINGULRITY_DEF = PROJECT_DIR / ".devcontainer" / "Singularity.def"
SINGULARITY_SIF = PROJECT_DIR / ".devcontainer" / "Singularity.sif"

SUBMITIT_DIR = PROJECT_DIR / "slurm" / "submitit"
SUBMITIT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

n_cpus = 12
hours = 4
mem = {
    "big": 32.,
    "medium": 16.,
    "small": 8.
}

executor = submitit.AutoExecutor(folder=str(SUBMITIT_DIR / "%j"))

executor.update_parameters(
    timeout_min=hours * 60,
    slurm_partition="hsph",
    mem_gb=mem["big"],
    cpus_per_task=n_cpus,
    slurm_job_name=f"launch-{PROJECT_NAME}-container"
)

runtime_command = [
    "set -euo pipefail",
    "export SPACK_DISABLE_LOCAL_CONFIG=true",
    "export SPACK_USER_CONFIG_PATH=/work/.spack/user-config",
    "export SPACK_USER_CACHE_PATH=/work/.spack/user-cache",
    "export SPACK_MISC_CACHE_PATH=/work/.spack/misc-cache",
    "export SPACK_SOURCE_CACHE=/work/.spack/source-cache",
    'export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="/work/.spack-env/view/lib:/work/.spack-env/view/lib64:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}"',
    "export S2_FORCE_BUNDLED_ABSEIL=1",
    "mkdir -p /work /work/.spack/user-config /work/.spack/user-cache /work/.spack/misc-cache /work/.spack/source-cache",
    ". /opt/spack/share/spack/setup-env.sh",
    "cd /work",
    "spack env activate -d .",
    "spack concretize",
    "spack install --deprecated --fail-fast -j12 --no-checksum",
    "rv sync || true",
]
runtime_command

```

```{python}
show_spython(spython_exec("cd /work && . /opt/spack/share/spack/setup-env.sh && spack env activate -d . && spack install && spack env st", image=SINGULARITY_SIF, bind_project=True))
```

```{python}
def launch_container():
    # show_spython doesn't work here because
    # submitit pickles the stdout and stderr
    result=spython_exec(
        " && ".join(runtime_command),
        image=SINGULARITY_SIF,
        bind_project=True,
    )
    return result

job = executor.submit(launch_container)
job.job_id
```

Pretty print is in the `job.results()`:

```{python}
job_results = job.results().pop()
```

```{python}
show_spython(job_results)
```

With that, the project should have the spack stack installed in
the _project space_ under `PROJECT_DIR/.spack`, which in the container
is `/work/.spack`. You can now launch the VSCode server by running the `launch_container` function in a new notebook cell.

```{python}
runtime_command.append(
    "code-server --bind-addr 0.0.0.0:${PORT:-8026} /work"
)

hours = 4
n_cpus = 12

executor.update_parameters(
    timeout_min=hours * 60,
    slurm_partition="hsph",
    mem_gb=mem["big"],
    cpus_per_task=n_cpus,
    slurm_job_name=f"launch-{PROJECT_NAME}-container"
)

# now explicitly require runtime command so that it updates
def launch_container(runtime_commands=runtime_command):
    # show_spython doesn't work here because
    # submitit pickles the stdout and stderr
    result=spython_exec(
        " && ".join(runtime_commands),
        image=SINGULARITY_SIF,
        bind_project=True,
    )
    return result

job = executor.submit(launch_container, runtime_command)
job.job_id

```
